records.title: dVLM-AD: Enhance Diffusion Vision-Language-Model for Driving via Controllable Reasoning
records.reason: Read the primary diffusion-VLM method and driving experiments. dVLM-AD uses iterative diffusion reasoning for end-to-end autonomous driving perception/planning; its target is driving control and not LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: X-Humanoid: Robotize Human Videos to Generate Humanoid Videos at Scale
records.reason: The work creates robotized humanoid video training data and a video-editing pipeline; it is a robotics dataset/training contribution rather than LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Joint Semantic-Channel Coding and Modulation for Token Communications
records.reason: Read the primary method and evaluation. The paper jointly codes semantic/channel information and modulates tokens for communication over a channel; its optimization target is communication reliability/resource use, not computation or memory of LLM inference.

records.title: DiningBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Perception and Reasoning in the Dietary Domain
records.reason: DiningBench is a dietary-domain multimodal perception/reasoning benchmark, not an inference efficiency method.
